# Scottsdale Sprinters

> Luxury chauffeured transportation in Scottsdale, Phoenix and across Arizona: executive Mercedes Sprinters, limo Sprinters, party buses (up to 30 passengers), executive mini-buses and a Premium SUV. Airport transfers, weddings, corporate travel, bachelor/bachelorette parties, golf outings, game days and private day tours to Sedona and the Grand Canyon. https://scottsdalesprinters.com

- Phone: (480) 771-4719 · Email: reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com
- Proof: 5-star Google rating (482 Google reviews), 4.9 stars on Yelp, 1,028 reviews across Google, Yelp and more.
- Pricing: every vehicle is booked by the hour at a published hourly rate ($125–$325) with a published minimum; no per-seat pricing, no hidden fees. A 50% deposit confirms the booking.
- Fleet size: 15 vehicles. Services: 16. Experiences: 15. Day tours: 15.
